metrics.label: Fantasy pts/game
metrics.means: Half-PPR points per game (Yahoo default scoring for K and DEF).

metrics.label: Expected pts/game
metrics.means: What his volume should score (nflverse expected points).

metrics.label: Pts over expected/game
metrics.means: Scoring above (+) or below (−) his opportunity.

metrics.label: Snap share
metrics.means: Share of his offense's plays he was on the field for.

metrics.label: Routes/game (est.)
metrics.means: Snap share × team dropbacks — nflverse has no charted routes.

metrics.label: Target share
metrics.means: His share of his team's targets.

metrics.label: Targets per route (est.)
metrics.means: How often he's thrown to when he runs a route.

metrics.label: Air-yards share
metrics.means: Share of the team's downfield targets.

metrics.label: aDOT
metrics.means: Average depth of target, in yards.

metrics.label: Carry share
metrics.means: His share of his team's carries.
